title: Boss: The Lazy Architect
briefing: The vault's lazy architect accepted deliveries in sorted order, so the vault collapsed into one long corridor - every room hangs off the right side. Reach the deepest treasure before the shrinking alarm catches you, and learn why the architect was fired.
hints: Sorted inserts always go right: the tree is as tall as it has rooms.
There is only one path - speed matters, so do not misclick.
